summary: Delete a markup from a proposal
description:
Returns 204. Use markup_id from GET Estimate Summary markups[].id.
Normal markups are removed from the summary.
Legacy Overhead and Discount stay in place with status: Disabled and value: 0
so a later create can re-enable the same row. The deleted id is stripped from other markups' compound_with.

parameters.name: markup_id
parameters.description: Markup Id from a markup's id on GET Estimate Summary (markups)

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.
